title: New River Hundred cadastral survey map, 1898
credit: W. Deverell; Department of Lands and Survey; Archives New Zealand DABB D101 423/IN 38 (R6617598)
altText: Nineteenth-century New Zealand cadastral map of New River Hundred with survey parcel boundaries and markings.
caption: Map of New River Hundred, 1898, one of a set of cadastral maps produced by the Department of Lands and Survey.
context: A surviving example of printed cadastral cartography documenting land parcels long before nationwide digital cadastral databases.
